components.gap: An imported HOL completeness obligation stands as a citation in place of a proof: handbook/restoration/inherited-12537-12673.tex lines 36-47 ('Cited theorem.') assert that, for the typed formula system and general structures of Henkin 1950 pp. 81-91, a formula is a theorem of that system iff it is valid in that source's general structures. The handbook proves completeness for Church's 1940 system and for the matched relational calculus, but no handbook text proves the cited statement for Henkin's own system or proves that Henkin's system coincides with, or reduces to, the proved one. Every imported HOL rule/completeness obligation must be supplied; this one is not. Fixing the exact system needs the unheld Henkin 1950 article. The other half (full semantics and its nonaxiomatizability distinguished from Henkin completeness, with proofs) is present.
